summary: Frontend adds a new actor-initialization hook with a 15s timeout, surfaces initialization/query errors to the main view via an ErrorBanner, and provides a Retry path. However, the backend-side hardening/timeout requirement is not evidenced, and the main view can still show an unbounded skeleton if Internet Identity initialization never resolves. Several unrelated UI/theming and feature changes appear in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Harden actor initialization so it cannot hang indefinitely: wrap actor creation and `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(...)` in a timeout and propagate timeout/initialization errors through `useActor()` so `useHabits()`/`BecomingView` can render an error instead of remaining stuck in a loading state.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a frontend-only timeout wrapper (`useActorWithTimeout`) racing actor creation vs. a 15s timer, but there is no evidence of backend-side timeout/hardening for `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(...)` or actor creation. The only backend change shown is additional/changed canister logic without any explicit timeout/initialization-hardening mechanism.

missing_requirements.requirement: Adjust the loading-state logic in the main view so that it does not rely on a condition that can remain true indefinitely and so that error states take precedence over skeleton rendering for authenticated users.
missing_requirements.reason: BecomingView still renders the skeleton whenever `isInitializing` is true. If Internet Identity initialization can hang indefinitely on mobile, the UI can still remain in the skeleton state without transitioning to an error/data state, contrary to the requirement to avoid unbounded conditions.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed user profile endpoints and related authorization checks in the backend canister.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is focused on fixing the loading/skeleton hang and adding retry/error handling; it does not request new backend user-profile APIs.

hallucinated_features.description: Broad UI/theming and component behavior changes (e.g., new Cyber-Professional theme tokens, touch-optimized month tabs, header/footer/heart icon, toast notification usage).
hallucinated_features.reason: These appear unrelated to the stated non-goal of avoiding new product features beyond fixing loading/skeleton and adding retry/error handling.
